description: Planning Data is a beta government platform for planning and housing data in England, built so that services informing planning and housing decisions can use authoritative, up-to-date data. It offers an interactive map, search and bulk download, an API, and routes for organisations to provide and check data and to co-design new data specifications. On 26 September 2026 its API listed 222 datasets, all under the Open Government Licence v3.0, with about 25.4 million entities, including planning applications (100,627), brownfield land (37,736 sites), listed buildings (382,270), conservation areas (10,667), Article 4 direction areas, tree preservation zones, flood risk zones, green belt, local plans and design codes. Coverage: England, with completeness varying by dataset and by providing authority. Access: free map, downloads and API. Licence: OGL v3.0. Caveats: the service is in beta, and many datasets depend on local authorities publishing their data. Simulation uses are development sites, constraints and designations for future building stock, heritage exposure and land use scenarios. Related records: the listed buildings and conservation areas records drawn from this platform, and UK PlanIt.
